sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Princess are centered around cleaning up the princess's rooms and preparing for the royal ball. Players will need to collect and dispose of trash, dust furniture, and arrange decorative items in each room. The game features a variety of rooms, including the dressing room, makeup room, and royal garden, each with its own set of challenges and tasks.

Players will also need to prepare delicious meals and desserts for the royal ball, using a variety of ingredients and recipes. This involves collecting ingredients, cooking meals, and serving them to the guests. As players progress through the game, they'll unlock new recipes, ingredients, and cooking techniques, making it easier to prepare more complex dishes.

The game also features a variety of mini-games and challenges that will test players' skills and reflexes. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Princess are engaging, addictive, and challenging, making it a great game for players of all ages and skill levels.
